goals.title: Add frozen evaluation corpus and deterministic corpus hash
goals.description: Create a frozen, self-contained evaluation corpus checked into the repo (under a stable path inside the package or repo data directory) containing at least 3 user stories with hand-curated expected security requirements. Expose a Python API: FROZEN_CORPUS_PATH (Path), load_frozen_corpus() (returns list of dicts with user_story and expected_requirements), and compute_corpus_hash(path: Path) -> str returning a hex digest that is order-independent over filesystem iteration and changes when any file's content changes. This is the foundation every later leaf depends on.

goals.title: Add deterministic mock LLM for reproducible generation
goals.description: Create a DeterministicMockLLM class in secreqgen.evaluation.mock_llm that returns byte-identical output for identical (seed, prompt) pairs across instances and process restarts. The class should expose a generate(prompt: str) -> str method and a constructor accepting a seed integer. It must produce text that resembles a security requirement (contains 'shall' / 'must' / 'requirement') so it can be parsed by the existing pipeline downstream. This is the determinism substrate that makes byte-stability achievable when Ollama is non-deterministic.

goals.title: Add reproducibility report schema with stable JSON serialization
goals.description: Define ReproducibilityReport (Pydantic model) with fields: seed (int), corpus_hash (str), per_story (list of per-story metric records, each with story_id, phase1, phase2 each containing precision/recall/f1 floats), and aggregate (dict with phase1/phase2 each containing precision/recall/f1). Provide serialize_report(report) -> str that emits sorted-key JSON with stable float formatting. Provide normalize_for_comparison(dict) -> dict that strips volatile fields (timestamps, absolute paths, hostname) so two runs can be compared. This is the output contract for g4 and the comparison primitive for g5.

goals.title: Wire `secreqgen evaluate reproduce` CLI command
goals.description: Add a Typer subcommand `evaluate reproduce` that accepts --output PATH and --seed INT (default 42). It loads the frozen corpus (g1), uses the deterministic mock LLM (g2) to generate requirements for both phase1 (zero-shot) and phase2 (RAG) by calling into the existing evaluation pipeline under src/secreqgen/evaluation/, computes per-user-story precision/recall/f1 plus an aggregate, builds a ReproducibilityReport (g3), and writes it to --output as JSON via serialize_report. Must run offline using only the mock LLM.

goals.title: Verify byte-stability across two reproduce invocations
goals.description: Add an integration test that invokes `evaluate reproduce` twice with the same seed via Typer's CliRunner, normalizes both outputs with normalize_for_comparison (g3) to strip volatile fields, and asserts byte-equality of the deterministic portions including per_story metrics, aggregate, seed, and corpus_hash. This is the meta-verification of the whole reproducibility property and corresponds directly to done-criterion #4.

goals.title: Document reproducibility procedure in docs/reproducibility.md
goals.description: Create docs/reproducibility.md explaining: (1) how to run `poetry run secreqgen evaluate reproduce --output report.json`, (2) which fields are deterministic (seed, corpus_hash, per_story, aggregate) versus volatile (timestamps, absolute paths, hostname), (3) how to debug drift if reports diverge, and (4) the documented limitation that real Ollama output is non-deterministic which is why the reproduce command uses a deterministic mock LLM. Independent of all other leaves except by reference.
